definitions.full: H1269. Birzoth ברזות proper name, feminine (?) descendant of Asher (perhaps בִּרְזָא foramen , Thes, or woman whose beauties are apparent ) 1Chr 7:31 Kt (Qr בִּרְזָ֑יִת ).
definitions.rootNote: probably feminine plural from an unused root (apparently mean to pierce); holes;
